title: Form: swing events + steps
instructions:
For each clip, mark the moments below and enter the step count. These are the ground truth for the form timing checks (DEC-095).

Side clips (8824–26, 8980) show release, slide and backswing best. Rear clips (8846–48) show steps, ball start and finish best. If a moment isn't clearly visible from this camera, press X (Not visible) rather than guessing.

events.label: Ball start
events.help: The ball first moves out of your setup hold (pushaway begins).

events.label: Top of backswing
events.help: The ball at its highest point behind you.

events.label: Slide starts
events.help: Your slide foot begins its final slide.

events.label: Release
events.help: The ball leaves your hand at the bottom of the swing.

events.label: Slide stops
events.help: Your slide foot stops at the line.

events.label: Finish ends
events.help: You come out of your posted finish.
